fragments.text: But even given that we regressed by 1 apparently codex-17 did overnight  manage to get 2 things to compile, or even 1?

reply_text:
㊥ (did codex-17 get anything to compile overnight) No. None of the 110 constants compiled for the first time after my pin (`claude-4-pin`, `cc05e83`). The one probe since then that newly reports a compile is `Lean.Syntax.getHeadInfo?`. It isn't one of the 110, it was probed on the unmerged linki4 branch, and codex-17 itself said it already compiled at `cc05e83`. So the net overnight result is no constants gained and one lost (`ParserFn.run`).

㊬ (how I checked) I went through every `ok` row in `PARSE-PROBES.tsv` and kept those whose commit is not already contained in `cc05e83`. Only `getHeadInfo?` remained. I also traced the 19: it is 18 constants that compile outright plus one counted as compiling inside its owner. `getHeadInfo?` was never part of it, so the new integration-only rule in `progress.py` doesn't change the figure.

㊟ (what did happen) Overnight work did produce intermediate movement:
- 16 merges since the pin.
- Several rows moved from one failure to the next. For example, `Raw₀.insert` went from a `RecursionError` to the `CoeT` stop and then to `ReaderT.pure`.
- `testParseModuleAux.parse` cleared the builtin7 leak.

None of those rows reached a full compile, and one of the merges (`e4e8b8b`) broke `ParserFn.run`.

㊢ (my branch) The `ParserFn.run` probe at the current head is still running on `claude-4/parserfn-run`. I'll report its result and then work back to what `e4e8b8b` broke.
